name: Defiance
description:
Increases Magic Defense |cFFFF9C27+500|r for all allies within a |cFFFF9C2715m|r radius.
Grants the |cFFFF9C27Prayer|r effect every time Antithesis, Mend, or Fervent Healing is cast.

- Triggers Sacrifice at 5 stacks.

Sacrifice:

- Decreases Cast Time -10%.

- Lasts 15sec.
- Prevents gaining stacks of |cFFFF9C27Prayer|r for duration.
